description: Use this when the host of a wedding plans how much wine, beer, liquor, and champagne to buy for the bar, for adult guests of legal drinking age. Zola's general estimate of the drinks, the 750 ml bottles of wine and liquor, the cases of beer, and the champagne for a toast, from the guest count, the hours of the bar, and the guests who do not drink (count every guest under 21 there). It uses Zola's planning rule: 1.5 drinks per guest who drinks in the first hour and 1 drink each hour after, the standard US pours (5 oz of wine, 1.5 oz of liquor, 12 oz of beer), and a default mix of 50% wine, 30% liquor, and 20% beer. For a beer-and-wine bar, give a mix with 0% liquor. It gives no price, recommends no brand, and names no store. Do not use for drink recipes, for where to buy alcohol, or for anyone under 21.

champagne_toast.description: Add 1 glass of champagne per guest who drinks for the toast. Default false

crowd.description: How much the guests drink: below_average counts 0.75 times the planning rule, average 1 time, above_average 1.5 times. Default average

hours.description: Hours of the bar, with the cocktail hour, in half hours, from 1 to 12

mix_percent.description: Share of the drinks for each type, in percent, that adds up to 100. Default 50% wine, 30% liquor, 20% beer

non_drinkers.description: Guests in guest_count who will not drink alcohol, with the guests under 21. Default 0
